name: com.chainstack/chainstack
title: Chainstack
description: Deploy and manage blockchain nodes across 70+ protocols, search docs, request testnet funds.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Chainstack API key as a Bearer token. Optional — search_docs, get_doc_page, get_platform_status, get_chainstack_pricing and contact_chainstack work without it. Required for the platform tools (projects, nodes, organization, deployment options) and request_testnet_funds.
